activity_summary: You cleared the board and Mistress Ansell called the tidiness repentance. She counted four candle-ends, for this morning only. You paid her fivepence for a quire she had by her and twopence for a new horn of ink. You had counted the coffer and you did not say the figure. The list of what is not done was left whole. Field's paper stayed at his shop.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid the quire and the ink, counted without speaking a total, and kept the list whole.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Counted four ends, sold the quire and the horn, and called the clear board repentance.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Added five and two, and did not try to add the coffer.

facets.activity: Paid fivepence for a quire and twopence for ink

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Four candle-ends. I have counted them.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have counted the coffer. I am not saying the figure.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: A struck line before the thing is done is a lie in a neat hand.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not trying names while I walk.
